author: JaDropping Science
description:
This is a much larger version for a previous copper tube and magnet demo, and I tried to simplify the explanation so that as many people as possible can understand, so here's a footnote: 

Since the copper tube is one solid tube, you might be wondering how current is induced since it doesn't seem like a complete circuit. The induced currents are called Eddy currents, and they are tiny swirling currents within the copper itself! Also, don't short batteries for fun, I just wanted a visual for the explanation. Have a great day!
title: Drop a magnet upstairs, catch it downstairs!
